title: Ñaawoowo nokku ceniɗo
intro: E nder waktuuji deeƴɗi jamma ɗii, ruuhu dewondirɗo noddi Yurmeende mawnde e nder cuuɗi ceniiɗi nokku ceniɗo. Duuɓi goonɗinal e muñal ngal ustataako ina jogori yoɓeede kaawisaaji gaddanɗi weltaare e ndonu annabaagal.
clues: Miɗo waɗa balɗe am e jammaaji am e nder dewal e nder suudu ceniindu, miɗo ñaago Joomiraawo am haa abada.
Mi mawni, debbo am ina 6eydoo 6uu6de, kono mi meecfaa waasde yaakaare e yurmeende Alla.
Mi hokkaama ɓiɗɗo gorko, ina wiyee Yahya, wonti annabi e lampa peewal.
Miin e hoore am ko mi annabi, nelaaɗo ngam ardude e Ɓiɓɓe Israayiil.
Miin ko mi iwdi Annabi Haruna, mi woniino limanjo e nder suudu dewal.
Mi halfinaama toppitagol Maryam yumma Iisaa, mi seedtiima kaawisaaji makko.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ruttii e leñol mum caggal nde hisnaa e liɗɗi

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
